Render subject facts as compact text

Source: R/subject_narrative.R
subject_narrative_facts_text.Rd

Turns the list from [subject_narrative_facts()] into the plain-text block that is handed to a narrator. It is deterministic and data-only, so it doubles as a readable, no-model summary of exactly what the narrator was told.

Usage

subject_narrative_facts_text(facts)

Arguments

facts

A list from [subject_narrative_facts()].

Value

A single multi-line string (empty string for NULL facts).
